## Summary of PR/Issue
PR #239 updates Sepo onboarding documentation for issue #231. The goal is to steer new users toward **Use this template**, recommend installing the Sepo GitHub App with **Only select repositories**, and add a clearer pre-onboarding checklist for Issues, Actions, app installation, and provider secrets. The PR changes four documentation files and is otherwise focused. The main remaining problem is that one setup-guide section still preserves older hosted-app prerequisite wording that now conflicts with the new guidance.

## Review
The PR is directionally correct and mostly satisfies the requested documentation update. One consistency issue should be fixed before merge because it affects the hosted-app setup contract and is currently locked in by a docs test.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Hosted app prerequisite remains inconsistent in setup guide | WARNING | [`.agent/docs/deployment/setup-guide.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/828710f2aea646144ad2dd50064331597052b664/.agent/docs/deployment/setup-guide.md#L42-L47) now recommends selected-repo App installation, but the same section and table still say the hosted path needs only workflow permissions/provider secrets or no extra repo configuration. [`.agent/src/__tests__/envelope.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/828710f2aea646144ad2dd50064331597052b664/.agent/src/__tests__/envelope.test.ts#L1195-L1197) asserts that stale wording. |

## Progress
- The PR already addresses the core issue request in `README.md`, quick start, setup guide, and install-existing-repository docs.
- Rubrics review passed and found the change surgical and in scope.
- Reviewer disagreement: one review marked the PR shippable with only a capitalization nit, while another flagged the setup-guide prerequisite conflict; synthesis treats the latter as actionable after checking the PR head content.
- Posted one inline comment on `.agent/docs/deployment/setup-guide.md` line 44: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/239#discussion_r3236613711
- No existing inline comments or review threads needed cleanup.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Hosted app prerequisite remains inconsistent in setup guide</summary>

**Cause:** The PR adds selected-repository App install guidance, but leaves older text saying the hosted path works “without extra repository configuration” beyond workflow permissions and provider secrets. The supported-auth table has the same omission, and the docs test still asserts the old phrase.

**Candidate solutions:** Update the hosted-app table row and sentence to list selected-repo Sepo App installation as a prerequisite while clarifying that users do not need `AGENT_APP_ID` / `AGENT_APP_PRIVATE_KEY` for the hosted path. Then update the test assertion in `envelope.test.ts` to check the new contract instead of the stale “without extra repository configuration” wording.

**Comments:** This is safe for an automated fix-pr pass because it is a narrow docs/test consistency change.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
FIX_PR: one unresolved, concrete branch change remains and is safe for automation to apply.

## Final Verdict
MINOR_ISSUES

## Action Items
- [ ] Update the setup-guide hosted-app table/sentence and matching docs test so selected-repo Sepo App installation is documented as a hosted-path prerequisite.
